items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: He started, I started him taking lessons from Miss Camilla Todd.

ctx.x: That's John L. Jr. Yeah. Right.

Ramon was born in 1940. Well, he started doing it. He's natural. He's got a natural talent. Mm-hmm. He started playing at about 10 or 12 years old. And what's his main instrument? His main instrument is piano. He started, I started him taking lessons from Miss Camilla Todd. You ever heard of her? Mm-hmm. She's dead now too. She's dead now too. Yeah. She's an old piano player around in the Orland Island, down in the district and everywhere too. Yeah. Mm-hmm. She's dead now too. Yeah. She's a old piano player…
